text: Coffee with Alana. She and Kieran got engaged in Lisbon last week, ring was his gran's. Wedding probably June 2027, small, back garden at her parents'. Kieran is already stressing about the budget, his dad offered to help but he's proud. Alana wants a folk band rather than a DJ. Need to send them a card before Friday.

Ben's really into Warhammer now, painting a whole Ultramarines army. His birthday is 14 November 2026. A decent brush set would go down well, he kept moaning about his cheap ones. His partner Sophie says the spare room is basically a hobby shop now and she's fine with it as long as the dog stays out.

Henrik and his wife Mette celebrate 25 years on 2 November 2026. Their kids are throwing a surprise dinner Saturday at 7pm. He has no idea. Don't forget to RSVP to their daughter by tomorrow. Mette loves gardening, particularly roses, so maybe a voucher for the garden centre from us. Henrik said she's been talking about a greenhouse for years.

Long catch up with Gabriel on the phone. He's playing five a side again Tuesdays and Thursdays, knee seems fine. Supports Spurs, suffering as usual. His sister Ana is getting married in March 2027 in Porto and he's best man, already nervous about the speech. Said I'd help him draft it. Ask him next week how the first draft went.
Sunil's choir concert on the 12th at half 7, he's got a solo and sounded properly terrified about it. Text him good luck that afternoon.
Aleksander told me the wedding is off. He and Krisztina split up in August, he's staying at his brother's for now. Quiet, but says he's ok. Check in with him at the weekend.
Tendai loves Afrobeats, saw Burna Boy twice this year. Collects vinyl too.
Francesca's 40th is Saturday 7 November 2026, party at the Crown from 8pm. She's after a decent pasta machine. Chip in with Sadia and Meera on something nice.
Anders and Fern finally set a date, 18 September 2027, at a barn near Hexham. Save the dates coming out in January. Fern's doing all the flowers herself, she's big into dried arrangements.
Picked up the dry cleaning, posted Mum's parcel. Car MOT Thursday at 9am.
Hoang mentioned his dad turns 70 on the 3rd of December. Big family meal planned at a Vietnamese place in Deptford. Hoang wants to get him a proper fishing reel, his dad's obsessed with carp fishing.
Krisztina is learning the cello, lessons every Wednesday evening. Grade 2 exam in February 2027. She says she's hopeless but it sounded lovely.
Sadia and Jamal's first anniversary is this Sunday. They're going to the Lake District Friday after work and coming back Monday morning. Remind me to message them Sunday morning.
Jun is mad on bouldering, goes to the wall near Old Street three times a week. Wants new climbing shoes, La Sportiva ones, for his birthday in January. He's vegan these days too.
Eamon Murphy rang, his mum's had a fall and she's in hospital in Galway. He's flying over tomorrow morning. Must call him Thursday to see how she is.
Delroy's son Isaac starts at Lancaster in late September. Delroy is proud but struggling a bit with the idea of an empty house. Bring it up gently next time.
Isla got engaged!! Leon proposed on Arthur's Seat at sunrise. She's thinking autumn 2027. Her mum is already making spreadsheets apparently.
Andile's band is playing the Lexington on Friday at 9pm. He plays bass, they do sort of jazz funk stuff. I'm going with Georgia.
Georgia is knitting a blanket for her nephew who's due in December. She's into crochet amigurumi too, sent me photos of a tiny octopus.
Duc's birthday is the 22nd. He's mentioned the new Zelda about three times so that's the hint.
Quick one. Esther's retirement do got cancelled because her husband Peter is ill. She's rescheduling for spring. Should send her flowers this week.
Meera and her partner Chloe are doing a pottery course together on Saturday mornings. Meera says she's terrible, Chloe's a natural. Their wedding anniversary is 30 October, three years.

Ana Popescu, aka Annie, is running the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026. Training's going well but her calf is playing up. Ask after the calf next time. Her boyfriend Florin is going out to watch, and they're staying on in Spain for a few days afterwards to celebrate her 30th on the 9th.
Sophie said Arturo has proposed. They're keeping it quiet until they tell his parents in Mexico over Christmas. Wedding maybe late 2027.
Jamal is a huge Arsenal fan, season ticket holder, goes with his dad and his uncle every home game. His birthday's next month, 19 November. Retro shirt maybe?
Chloe's dog Biscuit had his op on Monday, he's recovering ok but in a cone and miserable. Chloe hasn't slept much.
Arturo told me about his chess club, he's rated about 1600 now and plays a tournament in Leeds on 14 March 2027. He's not nervous, more excited. Wants a nice wooden board one day.

Lunch with Florin and Sunil. Florin's brother Mihai got married in Bucharest in September, three days of celebrations. Sunil's planning a trip to Kerala in February 2027 for his cousin's wedding. Ask Florin for the photos. Sunil's a bit worried about the cost of the trip but his parents are covering the flights. Florin's training for a sprint triathlon next summer, swims at 6am most mornings.
Kieran's mum's 60th is on 9 January 2027 and he's organising a surprise party at the cricket club. Asked if I could do the cake. Need to confirm by the end of the week.
Alana's been doing Duolingo Portuguese every night, 200 day streak, getting ready for the honeymoon. Loves Fado now too.
Just me tonight. Booked the climbing taster for Saturday at 10am. Start running again Monday.

Ben and Isla came round. Ben's started a sourdough obsession, his starter is called Doug. Isla is reading all the Booker shortlist before the announcement on 10 November. Lend her my copy of the Mantel.
Henrik is restoring a 1972 Volvo in his garage, spends every weekend on it. Wants it running for their anniversary trip next summer.
Gabriel's girlfriend Esther passed her driving test this morning on the first go! He's taking her out for dinner tonight. Send her a congrats text.

Talked to Tendai about his wedding. It's on 24 April 2027 in Harare, then a reception in Leeds in May. His fiancée Ruth wants a big church do. He's stressed about the guest list, his aunties keep adding people. Asked if I'd be an usher. Need to book flights soon before prices go up. Also find out what the dress code is.
Francesca's daughter Lucia turns 6 on Sunday. Mad about unicorns and Bluey. Party at soft play 2 till 4.
Florin plays FIFA online every night with his cousins in Romania. Got into Dungeons and Dragons recently as well, plays on Friday nights with work people.

Anders said his parents' 50th wedding anniversary was last weekend in Stavanger. Whole family flew out, there was a big lunch and speeches. Ask him how his speech went. His sister Ingrid sang at the lunch apparently, and their dad cried. Anders is thinking of getting his parents a framed print of the church where they married in 1976.

Hoang is nervous about his wedding speech too, he's best man for his mate Duc on 21 November 2026. Wedding at 2pm at the registry office then a do at a pub in Hackney. Help him practise on Wednesday evening.
Sadia is organising a hen weekend for her sister Noor in Brighton, 13 to 15 March 2027. She's looking at a cocktail making class Saturday afternoon. I said I'd go. Pay the deposit by Friday at noon.
Jun's girlfriend Kim loves Studio Ghibli. Her birthday is 4 December. Jun asked if I knew where to get the Totoro lamp, said I'd look.
Eamon's golf obsession is getting worse. Off to St Andrews with his brother Declan on 3 April 2027 for a long weekend.
Fern and Anders have a cat now, a rescue called Pickle. Fern sent loads of photos. Anders claims he didn't want a cat.
Delroy and his wife Marcia are renewing their vows in Jamaica for their 30th, December 2026. Their kids are all going. He's been learning to cook his gran's curry goat recipe for the party.
Andile is gutted, didn't get into the orchestra. Still keen to audition again next year. Don't forget to ask him if he wants to jam on Sunday.
Leon's into Formula 1 big time, Ferrari fan. He's going to the Silverstone GP in July 2027 with his brother. Would love a signed Leclerc cap, he said, half joking.
Must order the anniversary present for Mum and Dad by Wednesday, it's 1 November.
Krisztina's moving to Manchester in the new year for work. Leaving drinks are 11 December at 6pm at the usual place. She's sad but excited.
Esther was talking about her grandkids, the twins turn 3 in January. Her husband Peter is doing much better after the op, back on the golf course. She knits for the whole family.
Isla said her brother Sam is struggling since his breakup, not really leaving the flat. She's going up to see him at the weekend.
Meera's book club are doing Pachinko for November. She's hosting on the 25th at half 7. I'm bringing dessert.
Sophie's birthday is Wednesday. She's into candles and plants, has a thing for those fancy Diptyque ones. Get her one tomorrow morning on the way to work.

Catch up with Kieran and Alana. Engagement party is Saturday 28 November 2026 at her parents' from 4pm, everyone welcome, kids too. Kieran's mates are planning the stag in Krakow, April 2027. Alana's sister Maeve is maid of honour. Alana wants help choosing invitations, she likes letterpress stuff. Told her I'd send the Etsy shop link tonight.
Duc Wang got the promotion, team lead from 1 December. Celebrating Friday at 5:30 at the Albion. Take a card.
Ana's mum has her hip replacement Monday 9 November at 8am, Ana's taking a week off to look after her. Ana seemed anxious. Ring her that evening.
Arturo and Sophie's housewarming was cancelled, the boiler packed in. Rearranged for next month.
Jamal is coaching his daughter's under-9s football team on Saturday mornings. Proud as anything. She scored her first goal last week.
Henrik's daughter Freya graduated from Edinburgh in July, now doing a masters in marine biology. Henrik's bursting with pride. Ask how the masters is going at Christmas.
Chloe mentioned their wedding anniversary dinner, booked at Dishoom for the 30th at 8pm. Meera doesn't know about the tickets for the Hozier gig she's also got her. Don't say anything to Meera!
Mrs Walsh next door, Georgia, is turning 80 on Thursday. Her son is coming over from Cork. Pop round with a card on Thursday morning, maybe some of those lemon biscuits she likes.
